## Summary

Clinical psychologist and researcher with expertise in **mental health**, **emotion regulation**, **cannabis use**, **sleep**, and **intensive longitudinal research**. Experienced in designing and conducting observational studies, managing complex datasets, and applying advanced quantitative methods to clinically relevant questions.

## Professional profile

My work combines **clinical knowledge**, **quantitative research**, and **real-world behavioural data** to investigate psychological processes as they unfold in everyday life. I am especially interested in research that can bridge methodological rigour and practical relevance for mental health.
